title: 3 CalmBoxes for a Phoenix Group Home
purpose: Put three CalmBoxes in a Phoenix group home, so kids and staff have a way to calm their nervous systems whenever they need it.
summary: Funds three CalmBoxes for a group home in Phoenix serving foster care youth. A CalmBox is a small, personal device, FDA-cleared for anxiety and insomnia. The kids will use them most around family visits, and staff will use them to stay steady for the kids.
whatWeFund: Three CalmBoxes ($300 each) for a group home in Phoenix, plus training so staff can use them and help the kids use them. Once funded, this project closes — additional gifts go to the next open project.
whyThisPopulation:
Foster care youth carry compounded trauma — separation, instability, and often abuse. Most arrive at group homes already medicated, already in talk therapy, and still locked in fight-or-flight. Family visits can stir up everything. A CalmBox gives kids a way to come back down afterward, so the rest of the support they receive can actually take hold.

It helps the adults, too. A calm adult gives better care, so staff will use CalmBoxes to stay steady for the kids. To protect the kids, we don't name the home.
